included: rated, modified, postponed and declined offer responses
re-testing price and structure against sustainable premium and objectives
reconsideration with supporting evidence
alternatives for an uninsurable client and the on-record consequence of a declination
excluded: disputing the carrier's medical judgement
the client's medical decisions or treatment
any promise about what a reconsideration will achieve

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a revised offer, a reconsideration outcome, or an alternative carrier response changes the available structure

pros.claim: Re-fitting a rated offer before delivery keeps the coverage inside what the household can actually sustain
pros.example: a table-rated offer is met by reducing the face amount or shortening the level period so the premium stays inside the agreed capacity

pros.claim: A documented reconsideration turns an unfair rating into a correct one without starting over
pros.example: supplying current controlled test results and a physician letter for a condition the file recorded at its worst

cons.claim: Re-opening the recommendation at offer stage often loses a case that was effectively closed
cons.example: a client who accepted the original design walks away when the rated premium is presented honestly

cons.claim: Shopping a rated case takes time during which insurability and client patience can both deteriorate
cons.example: an informal search across carriers while the client's motivation fades

failure_modes: delivering a rated policy without re-running affordability or explaining the change
presenting a modified offer as if it were the policy applied for
creating a formal declination on record when an informal inquiry was available
acceptance_tests: every offer differing from the application is re-tested against the sustainable premium and ranked objectives before delivery
the client is shown the difference between what was applied for and what was offered, in writing
any reconsideration request names the specific evidence supplied
revisit_triggers: a new offer or reconsideration result arrives
the client's health or financial situation changes during the offer stage
an alternative carrier or product becomes viable for the rated risk

nodes.definition: Deliver the contract as a working meeting rather than an envelope. The agent compares the issued policy against what was proposed line by line, and names every difference out loud: class and premium, face amount, any exclusion rider or amendment, riders present or absent, and the schedule pages. Any delivery requirement the carrier attaches is completed properly, including a statement of continued good health where required and the delivery receipt, and any amendment is reviewed before signature rather than after. The free-look or right-to-examine period is explained as the client's protection, with its length and start trigger verified for the contract and jurisdiction rather than recited from habit. Beneficiary designations are read back and confirmed against intent, with any conflicting legal document flagged for the client's attorney. Premium mode and payment mechanics are set up so the first payment cannot fail silently. Delivery closes with what the client should expect next and how to reach the agent, which is where the sales process ends and the servicing relationship begins.

included: line-by-line comparison of the issued contract against the proposal
delivery requirements, amendments and the delivery receipt
explaining the right-to-examine period with verified length and trigger
beneficiary read-back and payment mode setup
excluded: the ongoing service cadence and scheduled reviews that follow
renewal and persistency management of the placed policy
resolving a beneficiary conflict with a legal document, which is referred out

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the issued contract differs from the proposal, or a delivery or examination-period requirement changes for the contract or jurisdiction

pros.claim: Comparing the issued contract to the proposal at delivery catches differences while the free-look remedy still exists
pros.example: spotting an exclusion rider added at issue and addressing it inside the examination period rather than at a claim

pros.claim: A delivery meeting that explains the contract converts a signature into an informed owner
pros.example: a client who can find their schedule page, name their beneficiary and state their premium due date after the meeting

cons.claim: A thorough delivery meeting sometimes triggers the free-look cancellation it exists to make possible
cons.example: a client re-reading the guaranteed page decides during the examination period that the design is not for them

cons.claim: Delivery meetings are hard to schedule and easy to replace with a mailed policy, especially at distance
cons.example: a remote client receives the contract by post and never has the differences explained

failure_modes: mailing the contract without any comparison or explanation
collecting a delivery signature on an amendment the client has not read
letting the examination period pass before a known discrepancy is addressed
acceptance_tests: the file records a line-by-line comparison of issued contract against proposal and every difference explained to the client
the right-to-examine period, its length and start trigger were verified for this contract and explained
beneficiary designations were read back and confirmed, and payment mechanics were set up and verified
revisit_triggers: the issued contract differs from the proposal in class, face, riders or exclusions
the client raises a question during the examination period
the first premium payment fails or the mode is changed

nodes.definition: Close the sales process with a handoff package that makes the policy serviceable by someone other than the agent's memory. The package contains the completed suitability file, the issued contract details, what was explained at delivery, the client's stated objectives and the residual gap they acknowledged, the beneficiary designations as confirmed, the payment mode and date, and any open item such as a pending amendment or a referral awaiting a professional's document. Alongside it goes the review-trigger list this specific case generates: a term conversion deadline, a level-period end, a funding assumption to re-check on a current-assumption contract, a rider option date, a dependant reaching an age that changes the need, an expected business event, or a health change that could support a rating reconsideration later. The handoff defines the definition-of-done for the sale; running the review cadence, keeping the policy in force and building the relationship over time belong to the servicing and book-building function that receives this package.

included: the closed-case package contents and its legibility to another person
the case-specific review-trigger list including conversion and level-period dates
open items carried forward with an owner
the definition-of-done that ends the sales process
excluded: the service cadence, contact schedule and retention program that follows
renewal, trail and chargeback economics of the placed policy
referral generation and book growth activity

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a life event reopens the case, or the servicing function reports the handoff package was not sufficient to act on

pros.claim: A trigger list captures the dated options that silently expire and cannot be recreated
pros.example: recording a conversion deadline so the option is reviewed while the client can still use it

pros.claim: A legible closed file means the client is servable when the agent is unavailable
pros.example: a colleague answers a beneficiary question from the file without re-interviewing the client

cons.claim: Handoff discipline is invisible work that competes with the next case and is easily skipped
cons.example: a busy quarter where trigger lists are never written and conversion dates go untracked

cons.claim: A trigger list can become noise if every case generates dates nobody will action
cons.example: dozens of low-value review dates burying the two that actually matter

failure_modes: closing a case with the reasoning only in the agent's head
omitting dated options such as conversion deadlines from the trigger list
leaving an open referral or pending amendment with no owner
acceptance_tests: the closed package contains every listed element and is legible to a colleague who did not work the case
the review-trigger list names each dated option with its date and the condition that fires it
every open item carries an owner and a follow-up date
revisit_triggers: a life event or client-reported change reopens the case after handoff
a dated trigger approaches and the underlying facts need refreshing
the servicing function reports the package was insufficient to act on

edges.why_related: the obligation classes only make sense once the agent knows which activities the license authorizes at all
the meeting's disclosure opening states what the agent can and cannot do, which is the boundary itself
heightened-care practice sits inside the care obligation class and follows the jurisdiction's senior-protection requirements
the permission-based meeting design is what makes the sensitive fact-find fields answerable truthfully
the audit verifies from documents the coverage the fact-find recorded from the client's account
sustainable premium is computed from the income, obligation and cash-flow facts collected
which riders are available and what they cost depends on the chassis they attach to
the premium-base definitions that drive compensation are properties of the product structure
the match is made against a sized requirement and its stated assumptions
the sustainable premium bounds which structures may be presented at all
the ranked objectives decide what gets funded first when the premium cannot cover everything
a permanent recommendation requires understanding guarantees, charges and the funding obligation being recommended
the file records the derivation, the alternatives and the residual gap the match produced
presenting guaranteed versus projected columns honestly requires knowing which contract elements are actually guaranteed
the replacement comparison is built from the in-force schedule and its documented terms
the application is submitted only once the recommendation and its rationale are recorded and consistent
underwriting evaluates exactly what the application disclosed, and its requirements follow from those answers
the offer and its class come out of the underwriting pipeline and define the variance to be handled
nothing is delivered until any difference between application and offer has been re-fitted and explained
the handoff package is assembled from what was delivered, confirmed and left open at delivery
the recommendation may not rest on a tax, legal or investment conclusion the agent is not licensed to reach
the applicable obligation classes dictate what the file must contain and evidence
a vulnerability signal overrides the standard meeting design with a slower, second-meeting protocol
the compensation conflict must be disclosed and its disclosure evidenced inside the recommendation file
the design that compensates the agent best and the design that answers the client's ranked objective are frequently not the same
edges.resolution_rule: the client's ranked objective and sustainable premium decide the structure; where the better-fitting design also compensates more, the compensation conflict is disclosed and the fit rationale is documented against the fact-find before the recommendation is presented

edges.why_related: the calculated requirement routinely exceeds the premium the household can sustain for the coverage horizon
edges.resolution_rule: sustainable premium is the binding constraint: fund the top-ranked objective completely within it, prefer a longer level term or a laddered structure over an unaffordable design, and record the residual gap as a client-acknowledged shortfall to revisit

edges.why_related: a client's own urgency to settle a protection objective now collides with the deliberate pace a vulnerability signal demands
edges.resolution_rule: care wins over urgency: an interim modest and clearly explained solution may be placed if it is affordable and understood, but the full recommendation waits for the second meeting and a passed comprehension check

edges.why_related: a structure that fits the current need better can only be reached by displacing in-force coverage whose value the client already holds
edges.resolution_rule: the burden of proof sits on the replacement: it proceeds only when the documented side-by-side comparison shows client benefit net of contestability restart, new charges and destroyed rights, and never before the new contract is in force

edges.why_related: a better risk class and a faster approval reward exactly the omissions that full disclosure forbids
edges.resolution_rule: full and detailed disclosure always wins: a rated offer on truthful answers is preferred to a preferred-class approval built on an omission, because the contestability period converts that omission into the beneficiary's loss

edges.why_related: a rated offer raises the premium above the capacity the client stated they could sustain
edges.resolution_rule: the stated sustainable premium holds: reduce face, shorten the level period or change structure to fit it, and raise the premium only on an explicit, recorded client decision after the alternatives were shown

edges.why_related: the non-guaranteed elements that make a permanent design attractive to present are the ones least safe to rely on
edges.resolution_rule: guaranteed elements govern the purchase decision; non-guaranteed elements may be shown only as labelled projections beside a reduced-assumption scenario, and a design that only works on non-guaranteed assumptions is not recommended

edges.why_related: the completeness of the health, prescription, avocation and driving facts gathered early determines how far the offer lands from the quote
expectations set by how the illustration was presented determine whether the delivery meeting confirms or contradicts what the client believes they bought
a premium set beyond sustainable capacity surfaces later as an early lapse the servicing function inherits
the in-force schedule must be complete before the gap can be computed, or the requirement is overstated
the replacement determination and its notices are completed with the application, and the agent statement must match them
a rated, modified or declined offer sends the case back through the matching logic with a changed price or structure
questions and differences surfaced at delivery update the recorded rationale before the examination period closes
a review trigger or life event reopens the fact-find with refreshed facts rather than starting from the old record

both price off age, class, face and nicotine status and both can end without paying, so the decision-relevant difference is the guarantee structure and the presence of cash value rather than the pricing inputs

conflict_axes.name: calculated_need_versus_sustainable_premium
conflict_axes.description: The requirement a needs analysis produces routinely exceeds what the household can pay for as long as the coverage must last, and the gap has to be resolved openly rather than by quietly shrinking the analysis.
poles: keep the premium sustainable for the horizon
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: fund the top-ranked objective completely inside the sustainable premium, use laddered or longer-term structures to stretch it, and record the residual gap as an acknowledged shortfall to revisit

conflict_axes.name: term_coverage_amount_versus_permanent_certainty
conflict_axes.description: The same premium buys a large temporary benefit or a small benefit certain to pay eventually, and which is right depends on whether the need ends.
poles: maximize protection during the vulnerable years
guarantee a benefit whenever death occurs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the duration of the need decide the class, blend the two where both need types exist, and state which objective each layer answers

conflict_axes.name: agent_compensation_versus_client_fit
conflict_axes.description: Product classes compensate differently, so the agent's economic interest and the client's interest can point at different designs for the same set of facts.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: decide on fit from the fact-find and objective ranking, disclose the compensation conflict at the recommendation, and document why the chosen design answers the top objective

conflict_axes.name: illustration_persuasiveness_versus_projection_honesty
conflict_axes.description: The columns that sell a cash-value contract are exactly the ones that are not guaranteed, and presenting them attractively competes with presenting them accurately.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: present guaranteed values first as the decision basis, label projections as projections, and always pair them with a reduced-assumption scenario

conflict_axes.name: replacement_upgrade_versus_in_force_preservation
conflict_axes.description: A new contract can genuinely fit better while the old one carries value that is destroyed by moving, including incontestability, an old risk class and existing rights.
poles: preserve the in-force contract and its rights
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: put the burden of proof on the replacement with a documented side-by-side comparison, and never terminate old coverage before the new contract is in force

conflict_axes.name: underwriting_speed_versus_pricing_accuracy
conflict_axes.description: Accelerated and simplified paths give a fast, easy client experience while a fully underwritten path usually prices the risk more finely and accepts more of it.
poles: choose the path that prices the risk best
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: match the path to the risk profile and the client's tolerance for process, and never present an accelerated quote as the certain outcome

conflict_axes.name: full_disclosure_versus_approval_odds
conflict_axes.description: Every disclosure that makes the application truthful can also make the offer worse or slower, which is precisely why the temptation exists.
poles: protect the quoted price and timeline
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclosure is absolute because contestability transfers the consequence to the beneficiary; manage the price question by setting expectations before the application, not by editing it

conflict_axes.name: closing_urgency_versus_deliberate_pace
conflict_axes.description: Momentum closes cases and protects a family sooner, while a deliberate pace protects comprehension and is mandatory where vulnerability signals appear.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep a normal pace for ordinary buyers but let any vulnerability signal force the second meeting, the written summary and the comprehension check before signature

conflict_axes.name: documentation_burden_versus_selling_time
conflict_axes.description: The file that defends a recommendation years later is written with hours that could be spent in front of the next prospect, and it is the first thing sacrificed under volume.
poles: maximize time in front of clients
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: write the rationale elements during the meetings that generate them and keep the file's required contents short enough to be actually completed every time

edge_cases.description: A client counts employer group life as their permanent protection, but the certificate shows a smaller multiple than they believed and the coverage ends with the job
edge_cases.trigger: group coverage is treated as owned, portable protection during the gap calculation
edge_cases.mitigation: read the certificate, record the actual multiple and the portability or conversion terms, and treat group coverage in the gap calculation as employment-dependent rather than as owned protection

edge_cases.description: An in-force term policy is approaching its conversion deadline for a client whose health has since deteriorated
edge_cases.trigger: the in-force audit surfaces a conversion deadline within a decision-relevant horizon
edge_cases.mitigation: evaluate conversion first as an option that requires no new evidence of insurability, obtain the carrier's current conversion menu and deadline in writing, and treat any new application as an alternative to compare against it rather than a substitute for it

edge_cases.description: A recently bereaved client wants to buy a large permanent policy immediately, using insurance proceeds they have just received
edge_cases.trigger: a grief-driven purchase decision inside weeks of a death
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the slow-down protocol with a second meeting and a written summary, size the need from the changed household facts rather than the size of the proceeds, and place nothing the client cannot restate in their own words

edge_cases.description: A client points at the non-guaranteed column and asks what the policy will be worth in twenty years
edge_cases.trigger: a projection is read as a prediction during the illustration presentation
edge_cases.mitigation: answer from the guaranteed column, explain that the other columns depend on carrier-declared or index-linked elements that can change, show the reduced-assumption scenario, and record that the exchange happened

edge_cases.description: Underwriting returns a table rating and the resulting premium exceeds the sustainable figure the client stated at fact-find
edge_cases.trigger: the offered class differs from the applied-for class
edge_cases.mitigation: re-fit inside the stated premium by adjusting face, level period or structure, present the alternatives in writing, pursue reconsideration where current evidence supports it, and raise the premium only on an explicit recorded client decision

edge_cases.description: A client denies tobacco use at fact-find and then discloses it to the examiner, or the evidence contradicts the application answer
edge_cases.trigger: underwriting evidence conflicts with an application answer
edge_cases.mitigation: correct the application through the carrier's amendment process rather than allowing the inconsistency to stand, explain the contestability consequence to the client, and never submit a signed correction the client has not read

edge_cases.description: An existing universal life contract is underfunded and drifting toward lapse, and the client wants to trade it for something new
edge_cases.trigger: an in-force current-assumption contract is failing its original funding assumption
edge_cases.mitigation: obtain an in-force ledger and test whether increased funding or a reduced face restores the contract before considering replacement, and if replacement still wins, document the comparison including contestability restart and any new surrender charge schedule

edge_cases.description: A business owner wants coverage to fund a buy-sell arrangement, but no executed agreement exists and the ownership structure is unclear
edge_cases.trigger: a policy design depends on a legal document that has not been drafted
edge_cases.mitigation: refer the agreement and its tax treatment to the client's attorney and accountant, record the referral, and hold the ownership and beneficiary design open until the executed document names the funding mechanism

edge_cases.description: A client whose first language the agent does not speak relies on an adult child to interpret, and that child is the proposed beneficiary
edge_cases.trigger: an interested third party is the only channel of communication with the buyer
edge_cases.mitigation: use an independent interpreter and translated materials where the carrier provides them, run the comprehension check through that independent channel, and stop the sale if the client cannot restate the policy without the interested party

edge_cases.description: The beneficiary the client wants to name conflicts with a divorce decree or a trust document
edge_cases.trigger: beneficiary intent collides with an existing legal obligation
edge_cases.mitigation: record the conflict, refer it to the client's attorney rather than interpreting the document, and confirm the designation at delivery only once the client has taken that advice

edge_cases.description: The client asks for a face amount that financial underwriting will not justify from their income and estate facts
edge_cases.trigger: the requested face exceeds what the economic loss supports
edge_cases.mitigation: reconcile the request to the documented need calculation, ask what the extra amount is intended to fund, supply the financial documentation that supports whatever is justified, and reduce rather than submit an amount the file cannot support

edge_cases.description: The issued contract arrives with an exclusion rider or an amendment the client never saw in the proposal
edge_cases.trigger: the policy as issued differs from the policy as proposed
edge_cases.mitigation: compare the contract to the proposal line by line at delivery, explain every difference before any signature, decide with the client whether to accept, amend or use the examination period, and update the file with the outcome

workflow.action: Set the advice boundary and confirm the preconditions for this case
workflow.description: State what the agent can address under the license, what will be referred out, and confirm licensing and appointment status for this state and product before any solicitation
workflow.artifact: engagement and boundary statement in the case file
workflow.gate: an active license and the required appointment cover this state and product line, and the referral boundary is recorded in writing

workflow.description: Disclose representation, carrier access and how compensation arises, secure permission to ask sensitive questions, and set the expectation that the meeting may end with no purchase
workflow.artifact: meeting record with the disclosures made and their timing
workflow.gate: representation and compensation disclosure preceded any product discussion, and no urgency or fear device appears in the materials or notes

workflow.action: Screen for vulnerability and set the pace
workflow.description: Observe and record vulnerability signals, apply the slow-down protocol where any appear, and establish how comprehension will be verified
workflow.artifact: care-adaptation note listing signals observed and adaptations applied
workflow.gate: for any flagged case a second meeting, plain-language summary and independent communication channel are scheduled, and the comprehension check method is set

workflow.description: Capture household, income, obligation, asset, health, lifestyle, business and beneficiary facts and the client's objectives in their own words
workflow.artifact: completed fact-find record with declined fields marked
workflow.gate: every field is populated or explicitly marked declined, and health, tobacco, avocation, prescription and driving questions were asked before any premium was quoted

workflow.description: Build the in-force schedule from policies, certificates and carrier statements, including conversion deadlines and group portability terms
workflow.artifact: in-force coverage schedule with document sources
workflow.gate: each contract shows type, face, riders, cash value and loan status from a document, term contracts show conversion deadlines, and beneficiary designations are confirmed against intent

workflow.action: Quantify the need and rank the objectives
workflow.description: Apply a named sizing method with written assumptions, net the in-force schedule to a gap, and have the client rank their objectives as time-bounded or lifelong
workflow.artifact: need calculation with assumptions and a client-ranked objective list
workflow.gate: the method is named, every agent-supplied assumption is written and client-reviewed, the gap is net of in-force coverage, and the objective ranking is recorded in the client's words

workflow.description: Set the premium the household can carry for the whole coverage horizon and stress-test it against an income interruption
workflow.artifact: client-stated sustainable premium with its stress test
workflow.gate: the figure is stated by the client, at least one stress test is documented, and no design above it will be presented as the recommendation

workflow.action: Match product class, structure and riders to the need
workflow.description: Derive class from need duration and ranked objectives inside the sustainable premium, attach only riders a finding justifies, and identify alternatives
workflow.artifact: written recommendation with alternatives considered and the residual gap
workflow.gate: every element traces to a fact-find finding and a ranked objective, at least one alternative is documented with why it was not chosen, and any residual gap is stated

workflow.action: Present illustrations and complete any replacement analysis
workflow.description: Show guaranteed values first with projections labelled and a reduced-assumption scenario beside them, and where existing coverage is affected run the side-by-side replacement comparison and its required notices
workflow.artifact: illustration set delivered plus any replacement comparison and completed notices
workflow.gate: guaranteed columns were presented first and acknowledged, no investment-return language appears, and any replacement carries a documented comparison and the jurisdiction's current forms

workflow.description: Bring the fact-find, in-force schedule, calculation, premium capacity, ranking, recommendation, alternatives, disclosures and adaptations into one legible file
workflow.artifact: complete recommendation file dated to the meetings it describes
workflow.gate: a reviewer who was not present can follow the reasoning end to end, and every disclosure, adaptation and referral is evidenced

workflow.action: Complete and submit the application and manage underwriting
workflow.description: Answer every question fully with the client reading what they sign, explain the authorizations, set evidence-path expectations, and track requirements to the offer
workflow.artifact: submitted application package with an underwriting status log
workflow.gate: no question is unanswered or softened, the client attests to reading every answer, the agent statement and replacement answer match the facts, and outstanding requirements are tracked by name

workflow.action: Deliver the policy and close the case into service
workflow.description: Compare the issued contract to the proposal, explain every difference and the examination period, confirm beneficiaries and payment setup, then assemble the handoff package and review triggers
workflow.artifact: delivery record, signed delivery requirements and the closed-case handoff package with its trigger list
workflow.gate: any offer variance was re-fitted and explained before delivery, the examination period was verified and explained, beneficiaries and payment mechanics are confirmed, and every dated option is on the trigger list

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because the advice boundary and the applicable standard of care decide what the agent may do and what evidence the work must leave behind; the discovery layer (meeting design, vulnerability care, fact-find, in-force audit) must be complete before anything is calculated, because every later number is only as good as the facts under it; need sizing, sustainable premium and objective ranking come next as the three constraints that jointly determine the answer; product mechanics sit beside them as the knowledge required to translate constraints into a contract; the recommendation, its documentation, honest illustration handling and replacement discipline follow because they can only be done once need, budget and objectives exist; and application integrity, underwriting management, offer-variance handling, delivery and handoff close the sequence because each depends on a settled recommendation and each is where an unsound earlier step finally becomes visible.

dominance_rules.rule: Licensing and appointment status dominates every sales activity in the case
dominance_rules.rationale: solicitation, quoting or recommending without the required license and appointment in the client's state is unlawful regardless of how good the advice is, and jurisdiction requirements differ and change
dominance_rules.trigger: a case involves a state or product line whose licensing or appointment status has not been confirmed for this agent
dominance_rules.action: stop all solicitation and recommendation for that case until current requirements are verified in that jurisdiction and the license and appointment are confirmed in force

dominance_rules.rule: Client suitability dominates agent compensation whenever the two point at different designs
dominance_rules.rationale: the compensation conflict is structural, so only a rule that always resolves it against the agent's interest is credible
dominance_rules.trigger: the design that compensates the agent more is not the design the ranked objectives and sustainable premium select
dominance_rules.action: recommend the fitting design, disclose the compensation conflict, and document the derivation from the fact-find

dominance_rules.rule: Guaranteed contract values dominate illustrated values in any purchase decision
dominance_rules.rationale: non-guaranteed elements can change within contractual limits, so a decision resting on them is a decision resting on nothing enforceable
dominance_rules.trigger: a recommendation depends on non-guaranteed crediting, dividends or current charge levels to meet the client's objective
dominance_rules.action: re-test the design on guaranteed assumptions and do not recommend it unless it still answers the objective, showing the reduced-assumption scenario alongside

dominance_rules.rationale: a lapsed policy protects nobody and leaves the client older, possibly less insurable, and out the premiums already paid
dominance_rules.trigger: the design needed to cover the full calculated requirement costs more than the client's stated sustainable premium
dominance_rules.action: reduce face, extend or ladder the term structure, or change class to fit the premium, and record the residual gap as acknowledged

dominance_rules.rule: Full application disclosure dominates approval odds, price and speed
dominance_rules.rationale: the contestability period converts an omission into the beneficiary's loss at exactly the moment the policy was bought for
dominance_rules.trigger: any temptation or client request to omit, soften or defer a health, lifestyle, avocation or financial disclosure
dominance_rules.action: disclose fully with detail, accept the rating or the delay, and explain to the client why an accurate contract is the point

dominance_rules.rationale: a sale a client did not understand is not a sale, and the harm falls on the person least able to absorb it
dominance_rules.trigger: any vulnerability signal appears, including third-party pressure, confusion, recent bereavement or a communication barrier
dominance_rules.action: apply the slow-down protocol, verify comprehension in the client's own words through an independent channel, and stop the sale if comprehension cannot be established

dominance_rules.rule: In-force coverage is preserved until the replacement is proven better and issued
dominance_rules.rationale: cancelling early can leave a client uninsured or uninsurable, and the value destroyed by a replacement is often invisible to the client
dominance_rules.trigger: a recommendation would terminate, reduce, lapse or borrow against existing coverage
dominance_rules.action: complete the documented side-by-side comparison and the jurisdiction's replacement notices, and keep the old contract in force until the new one is issued and delivered

dominance_rules.rationale: anything material that exists only in memory will be reconstructed differently by each side after a claim or a complaint
dominance_rules.trigger: a material statement about coverage, cost, guarantees, exclusions or compensation is made verbally
dominance_rules.action: put it in the written summary or the file the same day, in the same terms the client heard

dominance_rules.rule: The client's ranked objective dominates the agent's product familiarity
dominance_rules.rationale: defaulting to a favorite product is the most common way a technically compliant file still produces the wrong contract
dominance_rules.trigger: the recommended structure matches the agent's usual product rather than the top-ranked objective and need duration
dominance_rules.action: re-derive the class from need duration and ranking, and if the usual product still wins, document why against the specific findings

dominance_rules.rule: Referral dominates improvisation on tax, legal, estate and investment questions
dominance_rules.rationale: an answer outside the license is both unauthorized and likely wrong in ways that surface years later
dominance_rules.trigger: a case turns on tax treatment, entity structure, a trust, a decree or an investment comparison
dominance_rules.action: refer the question to the client's own professional, record the referral, and hold the affected design open until their document or answer exists

dominance_rules.rule: Re-fitting dominates delivery when the offer differs from the application
dominance_rules.rationale: delivering a changed contract without re-explaining it converts an underwriting outcome into a misrepresentation
dominance_rules.trigger: the offer differs from what was applied for in class, price, face, riders or exclusions
dominance_rules.action: re-test against sustainable premium and objectives, show the client the difference in writing, and deliver only after they choose knowingly

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm license, appointment and the applicable obligation classes for the state and product before the first client meeting
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a fully worked case that cannot lawfully be solicited, submitted or compensated, and a recommendation built to the wrong jurisdiction's process

anti_rework_rules.rule: Ask the health, tobacco, avocation, prescription and driving questions during the fact-find rather than at the application
anti_rework_rules.prevents: quoting a class underwriting will never offer, and the credibility loss of re-pricing a case the client already accepted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the in-force schedule from documents before sizing the need
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a face amount that ignores existing coverage and a whole analysis that has to be redone when the real certificate appears

anti_rework_rules.rule: Establish the sustainable premium before naming any product or producing any illustration
anti_rework_rules.prevents: designing and illustrating a structure the client will reject on price, and the rework of starting the recommendation over

anti_rework_rules.rule: Rank the objectives before choosing a class, and record the ranking in the client's words
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a compromise product that serves no objective well and cannot be justified later against the client's stated goals

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the replacement determination, comparison and notices before the application is submitted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a compliance re-do mid-case, a delayed issue, and the far worse outcome of old coverage cancelled before new coverage exists

anti_rework_rules.rule: Present the guaranteed column at the first illustration meeting, not after the client is committed
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an examination-period cancellation or a complaint when the client re-reads the ledger and finds the guarantees for the first time

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the rationale, alternatives and disclosures into the file during the meetings that produce them
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing a suitability rationale months later under complaint, when the detail that mattered is gone

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set expectations about the underwriting path, evidence and possible outcomes at the point of application
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a case lost to silence during a long evidence cycle, and a rating conversation the client experiences as a bait and switch

anti_rework_rules.rule: Compare the issued contract against the proposal before the delivery meeting, not during it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering an exclusion rider or changed class in front of the client, and a delivery that has to be repeated

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture conversion deadlines and other dated options on the trigger list at handoff
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the silent expiry of an option that no later application can recreate once health has changed

iteration_protocol.trigger: underwriting returns a rated, modified or postponed offer
iteration_protocol.action: re-test the offer against the stated sustainable premium and the ranked objectives, prepare written alternatives, and pursue reconsideration where current evidence supports it before anything is delivered

iteration_protocol.trigger: the client discloses a new material fact mid-case, whether health, income, dependants or an existing policy
iteration_protocol.action: update the fact-find and in-force schedule, re-run the need calculation, and correct any application answer through the carrier's amendment process rather than leaving the inconsistency

iteration_protocol.trigger: a vulnerability signal appears after the process is already underway
iteration_protocol.action: pause the case, re-enter the care protocol with a second meeting and an independent communication channel, and re-verify comprehension before any signature

iteration_protocol.trigger: a jurisdiction or carrier amends a suitability, disclosure, illustration or replacement obligation
iteration_protocol.action: re-map the affected obligation classes, refresh the forms and file template in use, and re-check any open case worked under the previous process

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier changes product mechanics, charge scales, crediting parameters or conversion terms
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the mechanics being explained to clients, refresh outstanding illustrations, and re-check any recommendation that relied on the previous structure

iteration_protocol.trigger: the client asks to reduce the premium after the recommendation is presented
iteration_protocol.action: rework the structure by reducing face, changing level period or removing riders whose findings are weakest, and never by trimming the disclosures or the documented gap

iteration_protocol.trigger: the issued contract differs from the proposal at delivery
iteration_protocol.action: explain every difference before signature, decide with the client whether to accept, amend or use the examination period, and update the recommendation file with the outcome while the remedy still exists

iteration_protocol.trigger: a review trigger or life event fires after the case has been handed off
iteration_protocol.action: reopen the fact-find with refreshed facts, re-size the need, and re-check dated options such as conversion deadlines before recommending anything new
